headline: Law extends VA memorial headstones and national cemetery burial for spouses and children of veterans and service members through 2032.
what_it_does: This law extends two Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) burial benefits through fiscal year 2032. The VA must continue to provide, on request, memorial headstones or markers for spouses and dependent children of veterans or active duty service members. It also keeps allowing these spouses and children to be buried in any open national cemetery run by the VA's National Cemetery Administration.

who_it_affects.group: Spouses and dependent children of veterans
who_it_affects.how: They remain eligible for VA memorial headstones or markers and burial in open national cemeteries through fiscal year 2032.

who_it_affects.group: Spouses and dependent children of active duty service members
who_it_affects.how: If they die while the service member is on active duty, they remain eligible for these burial and memorial benefits through fiscal year 2032.
The VA must keep providing these headstones, markers, and burial options for a longer period.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted January 4, 2025; benefits are extended through fiscal year 2032.
